methodology.ownershipModel: AI Data Platform is scored on its evidence, integration, governance, intelligence, operator and platform responsibilities; source-product business engines remain outside the denominator.
methodology.previousFormalScore: Build 422 was the last formal scorecard at 90.8%. Build 423 expanded operator/telemetry capability but was not separately rescored; Build 424 is measured against the last formal baseline.
methodology.evidenceRule: Software/feature maturity is separate from live external and physical-host evidence. HOLD/UNKNOWN/missing credentials or witnesses remain incomplete.
methodology.futureBuildRule: A numbered build must move this denominator by 5-10 percentage points. Once the score exceeds 95%, another numbered build cannot satisfy that rule without a documented denominator re-baseline.
